sticks.comment: One kit, funk pattern, no fill: kick on the one plus two pushes at the and of 2 and the e of 3, snare accent on 2 and 4 with ghosts either side, hats running sixteenths as a wash with the offbeats a hair ahead of the grid. The section levels handle the dynamics, so the grid is identical for 16 bars and nothing here is busier than the one.

lowend.comment: One line for all sixteen bars, eleven notes a bar: thumb on the root at the one, ghost at the and of 1, octave at the a of 1, root on 2, the octave pop on the and of 2, ghost at the a of 2, root on 3, fifth on the and of 3, octave at the a of 3, ghost at the e of 4, octave pop on the and of 4. Empty on the e of 1, the e of 2, the e of 3, the four and the a of 4 - the e of 3 is the kick's own, and the back half of the four is the guitar's. Root sits E2-A2 so the low end stays a bass, which puts the pops on E3, F#3 and A3 and therefore on the guitar's bottom voice on the F#m7 bars.

clavinet.comment: Three stabs a bar on the ands of 1, 2 and 3, rootless three-note voicings up at 64-80 so the clav sits a fourth above the guitar's scratch instead of in it, and nothing at all on step 4 of the bar. I stay out until bar 2 and let the section levels do the dynamics; the last six sixteenths of every bar are deliberately empty.

scratch.comment: Five scratches a bar: the one rings as the chank with the kick and the bass root, then dead notes on the e of 2, the a of 2 and the four with the snare, and the a of 4 rings as the answer into the next one. Four voices in the voicing so the renderer's top-three rule drops the root - the scratch lands G3-B3-D4, above every bass pop and a fourth under the clav's 67 floor. Steps 2, 6 and 10 stay empty because they are the clav's, and 3 and 11 stay empty because that is where the bass octave pops land; I am not on the e of 3 either, that is the kick's and the bass asked for it.

verdict.note: All four stay: nobody is fighting for the same register, so the single change that mattered was in the mix, not the roster - clav up 3 dB and the bass low shelf out 2.5 dB with its hp at 55, which takes 60-250 Hz from 49.4% to 42.3% and the render from 'too much mud' to clean.
